newsitem.title: USA: Gold Banc to acquire Kansas bank.
newsitem.headline: Gold Banc to acquire Kansas bank.

text.p: Gold Banc Corp said Thursday it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire Peoples Bancshares Inc in a stock transaction valued at $9.25 million.
If the average price of Gold Banc's common stock is below $10.50, Gold Banc can terminate the transaction, unless Peoples agrees to fix the exchange ratio at $10.50, gold Banc said.

The acquisition, which is expected to close in the third quarter of 1997 and to be accounted for as a pooling of interests, is expected to be accretive to Gold Banc's earnings per share in 1997, the company said. The merger must be approved by Peoples shareholders and by federal regulatory agencies.
Peoples is a a one-bank holding company owning Peoples National Bank, Clay Center, Kansas.
